svg.title: Heat-kernel diffusion propagator
svg.desc: What this figure shows: The diffusion kernel broadens while its peak decreases, preserving total probability. The plotted object is generated from G(x,t)=(4 pi D t)^(-1/2) exp[-x^2/(4Dt)]. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Closed-form physical map. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
